mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my custom patio project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor involves reviewing their portfolio, checking references, and ensuring they are licensed and insured in California. Look for a contractor with experience in custom patio designs and a strong understanding of local building codes in cities like Oakland or San Leandro. It's beneficial to select a company that communicates clearly and offers detailed proposals outlining the scope of work, materials, and timeline, helping you compare options effectively.
